chapters.title: Once there was a family who…
p: Once there was a family who had a refrigerator. It was getting very hot in the house and the family was very worried. Mommy went to the refrigerator and opened it. Inside, there was a big box full of cool air. "I can save us from the heat!" she said.
Daddy said, "Good thinking! That cool air will keep us cool."
Everyone was thankful to have the cool air to save them from the hot weather. They opened the windows to let the cool air out and soon mommy, daddy, and their little one felt so much better.
The little one turned to mommy and said, "Thank you for saving us, Mommy!"
"My pleasure," Mommy said with a smile. She was glad that the refrigerator had saved her family from the hot weather.

chapters.title: Once a group of children were…
p: Once, a group of children were playing in the park. One of them, Jill, was looking for something to do.
Suddenly, she saw a strange structure in the middle of the park. She walked over to it and saw that it had some funny shapes and colours.
"What is this?" she asked her friends.
"I don't know," they all replied, looking confused.
Just then, a strange creature popped out of the structure. It had a huge smile on its face and it was holding a wand.
"Let me show you what this is," it said.
It waved its wand and a castle appeared. Everyone was amazed.
"Amazing. Can you show us more?" asked Jill.
The creature smiled and waved its wand again. Mountains, rivers, and more structures appeared.
The children were so amazed that they didn't know what else to say.
"You are very clever," said Jill.
The creature smiled and said, "That's why I'm here to show you something fun and cool."
The children all thanked the creature and waved goodbye as it disappeared into the structure.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl who was feeling scared. She wanted to find something funny to make her feel better.
She saw some gum on the ground and decided to replace her scared feeling with fun! She bent down and picked up the gum and tried blowing a big bubble.
Just then, her older brother came over to see what she was doing. “What are you doing, sister?” he asked.
The little girl smiled cheekily and said, “I’m replacing my scared feelings with something fun - blowing bubbles with this gum. Wanna try?”
Her brother smiled back and took the gum from her. Together, they blew big bubbles and laughed until the sun went down.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a girl called Lucy. She was three years old and loved to explore the world.
One day, Lucy and her parents decided to go on an adventure. They all hopped in the car and drove to a special port. At the port, there were lots of fancy boats. Lucy was so excited to see them!
Lucy said, “Mommy, can I have a boat?” Her mommy replied, “Maybe one day sweetheart.”
But then, Lucy spotted something even better. It was a beautiful yummy ice cream! She asked her mommy if she could have some, and her mommy said yes.
Lucy enjoyed her sweet creamy treat while admiring the fancy boats. She laughed with delight as the cool ice cream dripped on her fingers.
After the yummy snack, Lucy and her parents drove back home. Lucy had a lot of fun at the port and couldn’t wait to go back again and explore.

chapters.title: One day a little girl named…
p: One day, a little girl named Daisy was in her room looking for something fun to do. She saw a pattern of colors on her wall and saw a big box of crayons. She started to fill in the pattern with delicate colors. Red, blue, yellow, and green, Daisy filled the pattern with lots of colors.
Suddenly, Daisy heard her mom coming. In a panic, Daisy quickly put away the crayons and hid behind her bed.
Mama asked Daisy, “What were you doing?”
"I was coloring a pattern on my wall," Daisy replied.
Mama smiled and said, "I think this pattern looks nice and very delicate. I am proud of you for filling it in so nicely."
Daisy smiled and thanked her mom. Then Daisy and Mama hugged tightly. Daisy was so happy she could make something beautiful.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a little boy named David. He loved the sea and all its creatures. He enjoyed the sound of the sea, the sound of the crashing waves and the bright, sunny sky.
Today he was going on a special adventure: sailing. He had a brand new boat with bright blue colours. His heart was full of excitement.
He put on his life jacket, grabbed his hat and stepped into the boat. His dad pushed him off the dock and off David sailed! He waved goodbye to his dad with a big smile on his face.
He was a natural sailor. His boat gracefully moved through the waves and the sun shined brightly on him.
David looked around and saw his dad waving and smiling. He waved back and shouted, "I love to sail!"
And the little boy went on a new and exciting adventure.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little boy called Joe who wanted to march. He put on his blue shoes and ran out the door. Joe ran up a hill and kept marching until he found a little creek. The creek was so quiet and peaceful that Joe decided to stay and play.

He watched the little fish swimming in the water and listened to the birds singing high up in the trees. Joe took some stones and started throwing them into the creek, making them skip across the water. He played for a while until he heard a voice.
"Joe! Where are you?" said a voice. Joe realized it was his mom calling him, so he said, "I'm here, mom. I'm at the little creek."
Joe's mom smiled and said, "That's a great idea! Come on, let's go home now."
So Joe marched back home with his mom. He was so happy that he had chosen to march to the little creek.

chapters.title: Tommy woke up early one morning…
p: Tommy woke up early one morning. He was very excited because he had a special surprise. He raced to his room to get ready.
When he went downstairs, he saw a big box on the table. His mom smiled and said, "Good morning, Tommy. Do you want to see what I have for you?"
Tommy nodded. He opened the box and found an icy book. "This is for you," said Mom. "It's a book and you can read it."
Tommy was very excited. He opened it and started reading straight away. He read and read, even after breakfast. He read until the sun was high in the sky and it was time to go outside.
Tommy smiled. He was looking forward to reading more of his book in the morning.

chapters.title: Once there was a boy named…
p: Once there was a boy named John. He was only three years old and already he loved golf. He asked his mom if he could play golf, and she said yes.
So one day, John went to the golf course with his mom and dad. He was so excited! He tried to hit the ball but it didn’t go very far. His dad said, “John, keep trying! You’ll get better each time.”
John tried again and again. He would swing his club, but the ball would only go a few feet. He was getting frustrated. But his dad said, “John, don’t give up. Look at how the professionals do it.”
So John kept trying and finally he hit the ball right into the hole! He was so excited. He shouted, “I did it!” His mom and dad gave him a big hug.
John had a lot of fun that day, even though it was messy. He kept trying, and that made all the difference.

chapters.title: Once there was a little girl…
p: Once there was a little girl named Amy who came across a toe on the ground. She was so surprised to see it.
Amy asked, "What does the toe belong to?" She looked around but couldn't see anyone.
The toe was cold, so it must have been outside for a while. Amy decided the toe must have belonged to a snowman.
Amy picked up the toe and began to look for a snowman who might have lost it. She searched everywhere, but couldn't find a snowman.
Finally, Amy had an idea. She ran back home and grabbed a yellow scarf; she tied it around the toe and put it on top of a snowman she had just made.
Amy smiled and said to the snowman, "Now you have a toe to belong!"

chapters.title: Once there was a boy named…
p: Once there was a boy named Mark. Mark loved adventure. He was always looking for something fun to do.
One day, Mark went to the park. He saw a melon on the ground. He picked up the melon and looked at it closely.

Mark was curious. He wanted to find out what was inside. So he decided to replace the melon’s green skin with something else. He looked around and found some cute stickers. He carefully stuck them on the melon to make it look even more charming.

Mark took the melon home with him and showed his mom. Mom was very surprised. She asked Mark what he was going to do with the melon. Mark replied "I’m going to open it and eat what's inside!" Mom smiled and said, "That sounds like fun! Let me help you."
So Mark and his mom opened the melon. Inside, they found some delicious, juicy melon. They both had fun eating the melon together. Mark thought it was the best adventure ever!

chapters.title: Once there was a little girl…
p: Once there was a little girl named Lila. She didn't like going to the circus because she was always so nervous. She always felt funny when the clowns where around. She really hated clowns.

One day, Lila went to the circus with her family. She was so scared of the clowns. But then, when she was walking in the circus, one clown came up to her and said "Hello, little girl". Lila was so nervous and she said to the clown "I don't like clowns. I hate them!".
The clown smiled and said "That's OK, I don't like them either". Lila was so surprised and said "You don't like clowns?". The clown replied "No, I just want to make you smile".
Lila smiled and said "Thanks". From that day on, Lila wasn't scared of clowns anymore. And she started to enjoy going to the circus.

chapters.title: Once there were two friends named…
p: Once there were two friends named Bob and Jack. Bob had built a very tall tower with lots of blocks. Jack was very proud of him and wanted to play too.
Jack said to Bob, "Can I help you build the tower?"
Bob said, "Sure!"
So they worked together to build the tower together until it was very tall. Then they both relaxed and admired their work.
Bob asked, "Can I show you something special?"
Jack said, "Yes!"
Bob showed Jack his special network. He had connected all the blocks together in a very neat pattern. Jack was very proud of Bob.
They relaxed and enjoyed the day playing with their tower. They were happy and proud of their work.

chapters.title: Tina wanted to organize her toys…
p: Tina wanted to organize her toys but she was feeling shy. She wasn't sure if her brother, Ben, would help her.
"Hey, Ben do want to organize my toys with me?" Tina asked.
Ben smiled at her. "Sure! Let's do it together."
Tina was so excited! She got peanuts to use as markers for the toys.
"We can put the peanuts here to show where each toy should go," she said.
Ben smiled. "That looks great. We can organize even more things like this."
Tina and Ben worked together and got all of Tina's toys in the right place.
Tina was so happy she gave Ben a big hug.
"Thanks for helping me!" she said.
Ben grinned. "Any time!"

chapters.title: Bella was three years old and…
p: Bella was three years old and excited to go to the park. She had been watching more birds and squirrels outside her window lately and wanted to see them in person. As she put on her shoes, her mom said to her, "Be sure to be calm at the park. Can you manage that?" Bella nodded and smiled.

At the park, Bella was amazed. The trees were tall and the sky a bright blue. She saw several ducks and birds around the pond. But what she was most excited about was all the oranges that were on the trees! She had never seen oranges on trees before.
Bella plucked one off the tree, put it in her pocket, and ran to find her mom. Smiling, Bella gave her mom the orange. "Mommy, I managed to find an orange!"
Her mom smiled and laughed. She gave Bella a hug and said, "Yes you did! You did a great job - let's all calm down and enjoy these oranges."

Bella, her mom, and their friends all sat down and ate the oranges, laughing and enjoying the sunny day. Bella spent the rest of the day running around and watching the birds, but she never forgot how she managed to find the orange.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a big scaredy-cat. His name was David and he was very frightened of everything. He especially didn't like loud noises.
One day, David heard a loud bang from the kitchen. He ran inside and saw that the fridge door was wide open. He was so scared, he started to yell "Who is there?"
Suddenly, he heard a tiny voice from inside the fridge. It was a mouse. The mouse said, "It was me! I accidentally opened the fridge door when I was trying to find something to eat!"

David was so relieved that he started to laugh. He said, "It's okay, little mouse. Let's find some food for you." The two of them searched around the kitchen until they found some cheese and the mouse was very happy.
David and the little mouse became good friends and they shared food together every day. They both laughed and played and David never felt afraid again.

chapters.title: Once there was a little girl…
p: Once there was a little girl called Daisy. Daisy was three years old and she loved going on the subway. One morning, Daisy was ready to go on the subway but it was raining heavily.
She told her mom, "Mom, I'm sad we can't zip on the subway today."
Her mom said, "I know, Daisy, but the subway won't be safe if it keeps raining. We could go on the bus instead."
Daisy said, "I want to zip on the subway. Please?!"

Her mom said, "Ok, let's zip on the subway if the rain stops." They waited and waited, and then finally the rain stopped and the sky was full of blue. Daisy and her mom zipped on the subway and had a great time.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a generous flower. She grew in a sunny field next to a big tree. The tree provided the flower with shade and the sun gave her warmth.
One day, the flower felt so grateful for all the things the tree had done for her that she decided to thank it. She stood tall and said, "Thank you, tree! You have been so generous and kind to me."
The tree replied, "You're welcome, flower! It's nice to be thanked."
The flower and the tree became good friends. Together they watched the sun rise and they shared stories until the night came.
That's how the flower and the tree came to be the best of friends. Every day, they enjoyed watching the sun rise and playing together in the shade.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a little fox called Fluffy. Fluffy loved to march and explore. One day, Fluffy saw a tray in the middle of the forest. It looked interesting.
She said to herself, "Let me go see what's on the tray." So she marched over to see what it was.
When Fluffy reached the tray, she saw that it was full of colourful, playful toys. She said to herself, "Wow! This looks fun!"
Then, a friendly squirrel appeared and said, "Do you want to play together?"
Fluffy smiled and said, "Yes, I'd love to!"
So, Fluffy and the friendly squirrel had lots of fun playing together with the toys on the tray. They laughed and played until the sun set and it was time to go home.
Fluffy thanked the squirrel for all the fun and said goodbye. She marched back home with a smile, excited to come back and play again another day.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Bob. He was hungry and he wanted to get something to eat. So he went to the kitchen.
He opened the fridge and saw a delicious lemon cake inside. He grabbed it and cut it into slices.
But when Bob wanted to eat his cake, he heard his mom shout:
"Bob! You need to take a shower first!"
Bob did not want to take a shower, he wanted to eat the cake! He started to cry and shout:
"No mommy, I don't want to take a shower!"
But his mom did not listen to him. She said that he needs to take a shower before he eats his cake.
Bob was so sad, but he knew that his mom was right. So he went to the bathroom and took a shower.
When he was done, he came back to the kitchen and saw that his mom had put a plate full of cake on the table. He was so happy and he ate all the cake slices in no time.
Bob was no longer hungry, but he was very happy and his mom was very proud of him too!

chapters.title: Peter was a happy three year…
p: Peter was a happy three year old. Every morning, he woke early and went outside to play. He liked to look up in the sky and see the bright, blue birds fly.

One day, Peter was in the yard when something special happened. He heard a funny sound coming from the tree. When he looked closely, he saw a little blue bird. He climbed up the tree and the bird said, “Hello!”
“Hello!” Peter said.
“My name is Lucy, and I’m looking for a new place to live. Can you help me?”
“Yes!” Peter said.
So he took Lucy home and showed her his original birdhouse. It was blue, with a little window and door.
“This is perfect,” Lucy said. “It’s just what I was looking for! Thank you so much!”

Peter smiled and was glad that he could help Lucy. He watched as she flew into the birdhouse and settled in. From then on, every morning when Peter woke, Lucy would be there to greet him, happy and chirping away.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Kay. Kay was very excited because it was pizza day! She got dressed quickly and rushed to the kitchen, where the smell of delicious pizza filled the air.
"This smells yummy!" Kay exclaimed.
Mom smiled and said, "I'm sure it will be very tasty, Kay."
Kay watched as Mom took out some plates and forks. Then she spread out some napkins and said, "This will be very useful!"

Kay quickly grabbed a slice of pizza and started eating it. It was even more delicious than it smelled! She took another slice and offered it to Mom, who smiled and said, "Thank you, Kay. This pizza is delicious."
Kay and Mom kept eating until every last slice was gone. Then Kay jumped up and said, "That was a really useful pizza!"

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a chubby little bear named Tim. He loved to explore the woods around his home. One day, he found something special. He discovered a big pot bubbling away. He peered inside and saw something he had never seen before - soup! Tim was excited to find this soup and he couldn't wait to try it.

He asked the pot, "What is this soup?" The soup answered in a bubbling voice "I am a delicious vegetable soup!" Tim was so excited. He decided to try some of the soup to see how it tasted. He slurped up a spoonful and smiled widely. It was so yummy!
Tim wanted to share the delicious soup with his friends. He ran off to find his pals. As he searched, he shouted to everyone, "Come on, come and try the soup I discovered! It's the best soup ever!"
Soon, lots of Tim's friends had gathered around the pot to try the yummy soup. They all slurped it up and smiled widely.
"This soup is so delicious," said one of Tim's friends.
"Yes!" Tim agreed. "My discovery was the best!" Everyone cheered and they all enjoyed the soup together.
The moral of the story: Discovering something wonderful can be even more enjoyable when shared with friends!

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a smart nurse. She was always happy and loved to skip around the hospital. Every day she skipped to the patients' rooms and made them smile.
One day, she saw a little boy in the corner. He was sad, so the nurse asked him why he was so sad.
The little boy said, "I want to skip, but I don't know how."
The nurse said, "Oh, it's okay. I can help you learn. Come on, let's try!"
So the nurse and the little boy skipped around the hospital. The little boy got better and better at skipping with each step, until finally he was skipping just like the nurse.
They both laughed and smiled, and the little boy's sadness was gone. From then on, the nurse and the little boy skipped around the hospital every day, making everyone happy.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a princess named Claire. Claire lived in a castle and was very popular.
One day, Claire went for a walk in the woods. She heard a strange noise and went to investigate.
Suddenly, a wizard appeared! The wizard said, "I can grant you one wish!"
Claire thought for a moment and then said, "I'd like to know a special spell!"
The wizard said, "No! That's too hard for you. I won't give it to you!"
Claire replied, "But why not? I'm very smart!"
The wizard said, "It's too powerful. I can't let you use it."
So Claire sadly refused and went home. She never got the spell, but she was still happy and popular! The End.
